edges.reason: Lever is a visual cue near the oak door — the only entrance to the hub room containing the chest
Chest provides iron_axe for efficient mining; birch corridor only accessible from hub room (spatial gating)
Pink_wool wall only reachable through hub room which requires passing through the oak door
Chest contains iron_pickaxe required for polished_granite to drop as item; granite only accessible from hub
Crafting table sealed behind birch_wood wall — mining reveals it for crafting with chest's acacia_planks
Nether corridor only accessible through hub room, gated by the oak door near the lever
Orange_bed sealed in alcove behind polished_granite wall — mining is the only access
Cyan_bed sealed in room behind pink_wool wall — mining is the only access
Clay at far end of nether corridor past nether_wart_blocks — linear path with no shortcuts
Lime_carpet in same sealed alcove as orange_bed — accessible only after mining granite

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because the player must locate and orient toward the lever on the east wall of the entry room at ~1,1,0. Player spawns facing south (default) so must turn ~90° east to face it. Max_distance=3 is achievable from the 3x3 entry room; facing_tolerance=40° prevents auto-triggering since player spawns facing away from the lever.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the player must navigate through the oak door into the hub room and approach the chest at ~0,0,-5. Max_distance=3 ensures the player is physically inside the hub room — from spawn at z=0, the chest at z=-5 is 5 blocks away, so this cannot trigger from the entry room.

Uses inventory_has because mining birch_wood blocks drops birch_wood items into the player's inventory. The scene places minecraft:birch_wood blocks which drop as 'birch_wood' when mined with any tool or by hand. Having at least 1 confirms the west corridor barrier was breached.

Uses inventory_has because mining pink_wool blocks drops pink_wool items into inventory. Wool drops when broken by any method (hand, shears, or tool). Having at least 1 confirms the north passage barrier was breached to access the cyan_bed room.

Uses inventory_has because polished_granite only drops as an item when mined with a pickaxe. The iron_pickaxe from the chest is required — without it, the block breaks but drops nothing. Having at least 1 confirms both tool acquisition and east corridor barrier breach.

Uses inventory_has because crafting acacia_stairs (6 acacia_planks → 4 stairs on crafting table) places the result in inventory. The crafting table is behind the birch_wood wall (enforcing mine dependency) and acacia_planks come from the chest. Min_count=4 matches one crafting operation output.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the player must navigate through the hub and northeast corridor to visually observe nether_wart_blocks at ~6,0,-9. Max_distance=4 ensures the player has entered the nether-themed section (the 1-wide corridor at x=6).

Uses position_near_with_facing because the player must traverse past the nether area to find clay at the corridor's end (~6,0,-12). One clay block is at y=0 for visibility. Max_distance=4 ensures physical presence at the far end. Facing_tolerance=60° accommodates looking slightly downward at floor-level clay.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the player must mine through the polished_granite wall to enter the sealed east alcove and observe the orange_bed at ~7,0,-5. Max_distance=3 ensures the player has physically entered the alcove (only accessible after mining granite at x=5).

Uses position_near_with_facing because lime_carpet at ~7,0,-4 is in the same sealed east alcove as orange_bed. Max_distance=3 ensures proximity. Facing_tolerance=60° accommodates looking down at floor-level carpet. Only reachable after mining granite wall.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the player must mine through the pink_wool wall at z=-8 to enter the sealed north bedroom and observe cyan_bed at ~0,0,-10. Max_distance=3 ensures the player has passed through the wool barrier into the bedroom (bed is 2 blocks past the wall).

scene_description: A fully enclosed multi-room dungeon carved from solid stone bricks. Player spawns in a 3x3 entry room facing south (default). A lever on the east wall serves as a visual cue/landmark. A closed oak door on the north wall is the only exit, leading to a 5x5 central hub containing a tool chest. Three sealed corridors branch from the hub: West (birch_wood barrier wall hiding a crafting table), North (pink_wool barrier wall hiding a cyan_bed bedroom), East (polished_granite barrier wall hiding an orange_bed/lime_carpet alcove). A northeast corridor connects to a nether-themed passage with nether_wart_blocks and clay at the far end.
task_text: Explore a sealed dungeon. Find the lever on the wall, then open the door to access the hub room. Locate the chest for tools. Mine through birch wood, pink wool, and polished granite barriers to discover hidden rooms. Craft acacia stairs at the hidden crafting table. Find all hidden items: orange bed, cyan bed, lime carpet, nether wart block, and clay.
design_notes: CARVE FROM SOLID approach: 25x7x25 stone_bricks filled first, then only intended rooms/corridors carved. Key spatial guarantees: (1) Entry room 3x3 at origin — only exit is 1-wide doorway at z=-2 with oak door. (2) Hub room 5x5 (x=-2 to x=2, z=-3 to z=-7) — central node. (3) West corridor carved to x=-4 only; birch_wood wall at x=-5 spans full 3x3 cross-section. (4) North passage at z=-8; pink_wool fills entire 3x3 opening. (5) East corridor carved to x=4 only; polished_granite at x=5 spans full 3x3. (6) Northeast nether corridor open from hub (no barrier, depends only on door). (7) Lever on east wall at (1,1,0) attached to solid block at (2,1,0). (8) Oak door openable by right-click, no redstone needed. All barriers are complete walls with no bypass routes possible.
